collectionVerification.authority: ASF exact fileID catalog record and official asset archive directory
collectionVerification.hdf5Evidence: Exact granuleId matches ASF sceneName; NISAR L2 PR GCOV identifier agrees with processingType=Nominal and compositeReleaseId
collectionVerification.maturitySource: ASF catalog/archive, not an HDF5 collection field; PR indicates nominal production, not provisional maturity

exceptionMaskAttributes.description: Bitwise OR of input data exception codes for each image pixel (0: no anomaly, 2: NISAR LSAR qFSP-H1 sample slip). Also includes OR of validity mask bits, where each bit is set on for fully-focused data or off for partially focused or missing data (256:HH, 512:HV, 1024:VH, 2048:VV, 4096:LH, 8192:LV, 16384:RH, 32768:RV)

maskAttributes.description: Mask indicating the subswath number associated with valid GCOV samples. A GCOV sample is only considered valid if it is generated from fully-focused radar samples. If at least one radar sample in the averaging set is partially focused or invalid, the corresponding mask pixel will contain the value 0. GCOV pixels outside of the radar acquisition extent are filled with the value 255

rtcGammaToSigmaFactorAttributes.description: Radiometric terrain correction (RTC) scaling factor to normalize backscatter coefficients from gamma0 to sigma0, accounting for local terrain
rtcGammaToSigmaFactorAttributes.long_name: Radiometric terrain correction area normalization factor gamma0 to sigma0
